messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: element_segment vs element_line
parts:
theme_segment is defined as follows ...

function (...)
{
gg_dep("0.9.1", "theme_segment is deprecated. Use 'element_segment'
instead.")
element_line(...)
}

so if you try to use element_segment() as a replacement, you get an
error. Should element_segment be replaced by element_line in the
deprecation message ... ?

Ben Bolker

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: element_segment vs element_line
parts:
On Sun, Dec 9, 2012 at 10:35 AM, Ben Bolker <bbo...@gmail.com> wrote:
> theme_segment is defined as follows ...
>
> function (...)

> gg_dep("0.9.1", "theme_segment is deprecated. Use 'element_segment'
> instead.")
> element_line(...)
> }
>
> so if you try to use element_segment() as a replacement, you get an

I would think so, since the functionality of theme_segment() and
theme_line() were merged into element_line() in the new theming
system.

Dennis
